exposure_statement: Inspected only the supplied manifest and anonymous Z00–Z06 raw/ruler PNGs, all with view_image detail original. No source identity, collector files, key, plaintext, prior annotations, other observer output, repository material or network source was consulted. No source or symbol-class identification was attempted. Nonexhaustive geometry-only annotations were frozen before further material.
instrumental_limit: Visual ruler interpolation at native scale only; no calibrated click or tracing tool. Coordinates are estimates, not pixel-exact segmentation. Box uncertainties generally 4–8 native pixels per boundary; paths are approximate center trajectories with comparable or larger error. Very faint ink, background marks, and overlapping dark strokes prevent exact connectivity judgments.

observable_components.geometric_description: Low undulating stroke group in the middle row, with two or more rises and a rightward terminal. Appears locally continuous, but separate strokes cannot be assigned to writing units.
Compact dark curved middle-row envelope immediately to the right of C1. A narrow light separation or contact at its left is difficult to resolve.

Overlapping vertical extent: upper-row narrow loop, descending return and rightward upper branch lie above a dark lower loop. This is an envelope of a possibly connected ink system across two rows, not one asserted unit.
Middle-row short angled rises over a low roughly horizontal base. Close to the right of C3; the visible gap is too small for a precise boundary claim.
Small isolated compact dark spot to the lower right of C4; separate from the large middle-row contours at display resolution.

junctions.observed_relation: The descending return in C3 approaches or meets the upward side of the dark middle-row loop around the row gap.
alternative_ownerships: The thin return belongs wholly to the upper-row geometry and ends at or near the middle-row contour.
The return and middle-row rising stroke share a visible segment or overlap; attribution to either row remains open.
junctions.reason: A dark narrow approach is visible, but the junction does not provide separate stroke edges or order of execution. Approximate path omits the dense contact.

junctions.observed_relation: C2 and the low dark portion of C3 are closely adjacent, with heavy ink concealing possible separation.
alternative_ownerships: C2 and the low portion of C3 are independent neighboring contours.
A joining stroke connects the neighboring contours.
junctions.reason: Insufficient visible light gap and no reliable centerline through the dark patch; abstain from a connecting path.
